title: Developing an AI-powered translation app to improve workplace safety at construction and shipbuilding worksites
summary: Crowdworks reports over 90% translation accuracy and user satisfaction in multilingual field testing of construction-focused Safety Talk.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: Crowdworks and an anonymized construction firm developed a translator using specialized terminology and worker feedback. The source reports field testing in more than 20 languages and over 90% accuracy and satisfaction. Injury prevention and wider productivity gains remain intended and have not been separately measured.
purpose: Improve communication of specialized workplace instructions across languages.
developer: Crowdworks AI and anonymized Company S
location: South Korean construction and shipbuilding worksites

ratings.reason: Field tests report over 90% accuracy for specialized translation in more than 20 languages, addressing terminology failures.
Multilingual field tests report over 90% user satisfaction with specialized workplace translation. Injury prevention remains unmeasured.

ai_role.statement: The account does not isolate AI’s contribution from the surrounding workflow.

evidence.citation: International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025). Project-submitted account, current as of June 2025. ITU provides no independent outcome evaluation.
evidence.title: Use Case 9: Developing an AI-powered translation app to improve workplace safety at construction and shipbuilding worksites

produced_by: The account does not establish conditions sufficient to reproduce the benefit.
must_hold: The account does not establish requirements for reproducing the benefit in other settings.

headline: Safety Talk improves specialized workplace translation
claim_basis: Sources: the makers' report. The cited evidence includes no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
